# ui::transition_storyboards

Namespace-scope declarations of `ui::transition_storyboards` from the tree and window headers.

The storyboards of the transitions, with the system's own animation timings. `offset` is where the element starts relative to where it ends up.

## Enumerations

### NavigationTrigger

```cpp
enum class NavigationTrigger
```

Header: `winui/ui/Animation.hpp`.

Which side of a navigation a storyboard is for.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `NavigatingTo` | The new page arriving on a forward navigation. |
| `NavigatingAway` | The old page leaving on a forward navigation. |
| `BackNavigatingTo` | The previous page returning on go_back(). |
| `BackNavigatingAway` | The current page leaving on go_back(). |

## Functions

### entrance

```cpp
TransitionStoryboard entrance(Point offset)
```

Header: `winui/ui/Animation.hpp`.

Entrance: from `offset` and transparent to rest, 667 ms.

### reposition

```cpp

```

Header: `winui/ui/Animation.hpp`.

### content_in

```cpp
TransitionStoryboard content_in(Point offset)
```

Header: `winui/ui/Animation.hpp`.

Incoming content: from `offset` over 500 ms, fading in from 50 to 220 ms.

### content_out

```cpp
TransitionStoryboard content_out()
```

Header: `winui/ui/Animation.hpp`.

Outgoing content: fade out over 50 ms.

### add

```cpp
TransitionStoryboard add(Duration delay)
```

Header: `winui/ui/Animation.hpp`.

An added item, after `delay`: grow from 90 % and fade in over 333 ms, starting at 166 ms.

### make_room

```cpp
TransitionStoryboard make_room(Point offset, Duration duration, Duration delay)
```

Header: `winui/ui/Animation.hpp`.

An item moved by an add or a delete: glide from `offset` over `duration`, after `delay`.

### remove

```cpp
TransitionStoryboard remove()
```

Header: `winui/ui/Animation.hpp`.

A deleted item: shrink to 90 % and fade out, 100 ms.

### popup_in

```cpp
TransitionStoryboard popup_in(Point offset)
```

Header: `winui/ui/Animation.hpp`.

An opening popup: from `offset` over 367 ms, fading in from 83 to 166 ms.

### popup_out

```cpp
TransitionStoryboard popup_out()
```

Header: `winui/ui/Animation.hpp`.

A closing popup: fade out over 83 ms.

### navigation

```cpp
TransitionStoryboard navigation(const PageTransition& transition, NavigationTrigger trigger)
```

Header: `winui/ui/Animation.hpp`.

A page transition's storyboard for one side of a navigation. Empty for [NoPageTransition](navigation-transitions.md#struct-nopagetransition).
